Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (November 22, 2018) from the Chief Purchasing Officer: Call Number: 9101-18-7164 Description: Telephone Information Service for Tenants; and Above-Guideline Rent Increases (AGI) and Other Tenant Support Services Addressing Landlord-Tenant Issues for Tenants of Private Market Rental Housing in the City of Toronto for a term of one (1) year, with the option to renew for two (2) additional one (1) year terms at the sole discretion of the City. Should the option(s) be exercised, the General Manager of Shelter, Support and Housing Administration, or his designate, will request the Chief Purchasing Officer to process the renewals under the same terms and conditions.
